title: Neon Nest: One Bedroom Nashville Getaway
description:
Welcome to The Lodge! This brand new 1 bedroom provides all the comfort you would expect in a new build, including premium amenities and ample space. The perfect home away from home retreat while visiting Nashville, we hope you enjoy our "Broadway" themed Oasis! 

☆Groceries just across the street!
☆Access to Gym & Steam Room
☆Just miles from the Gaylord Convention Center, DT Nashville, Airport & Opryland! 
☆Private Balcony 
☆EV Charger
★No pets allowed
★No parties allowed
★No smoking

The space
This unit at The Lodge is a one bedroom apartment with one king bed, one queen sleeper sofa, one full bathroom and an eat-in kitchen. You will be welcomed by a keypad entrance to ensure a seamless check in process. 

When you enter the unit, you will find a full kitchen with state of the art appliances and a sultry lightening experience. The living and sleeping area are nestled in the corner of the unit - the queen sleeper sofa and smart tv! The bedroom features a king bed and en-suite washer and dryer. The bathroom provides a spa-like experience with a tub shower and beautiful vanity mirror. 

There is a Kroger grocery store just across the street from the Lodge for any last minute groceries items or late night snacking needs that may come up! 

Have an electric vehicle? We have an exclusive EV charger just for you in our parking lot. Once settled, guests can explore the building's amenities, including a fitness center and steam room.

☆ King Bedroom: Sink into luxury with a plush king size bed, complete with high-quality linens and pillows for a restful night's sleep. This room has en-suite washer & dryer! 
☆Queen Sleeper Sofa: The queen sofa bed offers an additional sleeping space. 
☆ Kitchen: Whip up quick meals and snacks in the fully equipped eat-in kitchen. 
☆ Modern Bathroom: Refresh yourself in our sleek bathroom stocked with premium toiletries and fluffy towels.

Guest access
Guests will have access to their private unit, ample free outdoor parking on premises, and by request only, the building gym and steam room. To obtain access to the building gym and steam room, please review the house rules section and contact our team for directions and access!
 
Further direction to access the property and your unit will be sent to you via text message the day before your arrival.

Other things to note
**IF YOU ARE LOOKING FOR MORE SPACE OR DIFFERENT SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS, REACH OUT TO US AS WE HAVE MULTIPLE UNITS IN THE BUILDING!

★Upon booking, guests will receive a text from our team with a rental agreement. The agreement is to acknowledge our house rules as well as provide your email address which allows us to invite you to the door app for check in!
★Further direction to access the property and your unit will be sent to you via text message the day before your arrival.
★Rest assured, our team is around 24/7 for any emergency that may arise.
★ Review our additional rules for our mandatory Gym Liability acknowledgment.
★ NO PETS, parties or any smoking of any kind allowed. 
★NO SMOKING, the property is 100% smoke free. No smoking in the unit, building, or on any balcony. There is a $300 minimum fine for any evidence of smoking or smell mitigation required. 
★For tips on places to eat, things to do, & all things #Nashville find us on insta! @urbannashvacations. Ask us about our Linktree for awesome deals & partnerships we have!
★Check-in is at 4 pm // Check out is at 10 am. If you're looking to check in early or check out late, we suggest booking the night before or after your arrival. Otherwise, to be considerate to other guests, we cannot guarantee that an early check-in or late check-out request will be accommodated. Feel free to arrive anytime after 4 pm.
